mapping: All listed values become fields. Local translations/claims/ingredients are JSON envelopes with per-locale approval. No English fallback for Arabic product fields.
pack_scale: Nullable exact positive integer mm from approved dieline or founder physical-pack tape measurement, with source reference and date. Shared shelf physical scale is enabled only when every single has valid height/source and approved H1 with valid ratio. Otherwise neutral equal presentation height, never estimated relative dimensions. H1 crop must match pack extents for physical scale signoff.
placeholder_geometry: Nominal portrait crop reservation only; uses the same stage, floor and sourced millimetre equations as H1. Never satisfies media or measured approval. Approved crop ratio supersedes nominal reservation; revalidate actual crop footprint.
